note: Times are in seconds on a 120 BPM grid (one beat = 0.5 s, one bar = 2 s). Each line starts at `at`; its narration must end before the next line's `at` (render.mjs speeds a clip up to 1.25x when it doesn't).

lines.en: Claude Code on your laptop. Codex on a server. Cursor. A Grok bot. Agents in the cloud.
lines.zh: 笔记本上的 Claude Code，服务器上的 Codex，Cursor，Grok 机器人，还有云端的 agent。

lines.en: They all work hard, but they can't talk to each other. So you copy, paste, and wait.
lines.zh: 它们都很能干，却彼此不通。于是你只能复制、粘贴、再等待。

lines.en: One app for every agent, on every machine.
lines.zh: 一个 App，连起每台机器上的每个 agent。

lines.en: See who's working, which model it runs, and where.
lines.zh: 谁在工作、用的什么模型、跑在哪里，一眼看清。

lines.en: Add the sessions already on your computer, in one click.
lines.zh: 电脑上已有的会话，点一下就加入。

lines.en: Or send one sentence to an agent anywhere else.
lines.zh: 别处的 agent，发一句话就能接进来。

lines.en: Give a task, and watch the work come back.
lines.zh: 派一个任务，看着结果回来。

lines.en: Every task resumes the agent's own session, so nothing is forgotten.
lines.zh: 每个任务都续接它自己的会话，上下文一点不丢。

lines.en: And your agents hand off work to each other.
lines.zh: agent 之间，还能自己交接工作。

lines.en: Groups. Tags. Machines. Light or dark. English or Chinese.
lines.zh: 分组、标签、机器。浅色深色，中文英文。

lines.en: myco. The mycelium for your AI agents. Download it for Mac and Windows.
lines.zh: myco，AI agent 的菌丝网络。Mac 和 Windows 版，现在就能下载。
